evidence.source_statement: Preserve publication-safe references, licenses and hashes needed to explain imported data or resources.
source_conditions: When material from outside the project is incorporated
Applies only when expressly selected for a matching project or authorized development workflow.
This rule does not itself authorize changes to other repositories, publication or destructive work.

interpretation.situation_scope: Relationships describe relevant contexts, not exhaustive triggers or narrower rule applicability.
interpretation.intent_semantics: Intent relationships describe inferred underlying outcomes; normative authority remains with the original rule.
interpretation.effective_rules: No rule, rule profile, or execution instruction is altered by linking.
